filters.expression: try_cast(OBS_VALUE AS decimal(18,8)) IS NOT NULL

mappings.expression: concat_ws('.', FREQ, CURRENCY, CURRENCY_DENOM, EXR_TYPE, EXR_SUFFIX)
cast(coalesce(total_due_amount, subtotal_amount + tax_amount + freight_amount) as decimal(18,4))
concat_ws(', ', nullif(address_line1,''), nullif(city,''), nullif(state_province,''), nullif(postal_code,''), nullif(country_code,''))
CASE WHEN customer_segment IN ('CORPORATE','WHOLESALE') THEN 'B2B' WHEN customer_segment IN ('RETAIL','ONLINE') THEN 'B2C' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END

CASE WHEN customer_since IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN months_between(current_date(), customer_since) < 12 THEN 'NEW' WHEN months_between(current_date(), customer_since) < 60 THEN 'ESTABLISHED' ELSE 'LOYAL' END
email IS NOT NULL AND email RLIKE '^[^@]+@[^@]+\\.[a-z]{2,}$'
cast(coalesce(net_amount, quantity * unit_price - discount_amount) as decimal(18,4))
cast(CASE WHEN quantity * unit_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE discount_amount / (quantity * unit_price) END as decimal(9,6))

quality_rules.expression: customer_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(customer_key) <> ''
count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_key) = 1
email IS NULL OR email RLIKE '^[A-Za-z0-9._%%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
customer_segment IN ('RETAIL','WHOLESALE','ONLINE','CORPORATE') OR customer_segment IS NULL
product_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(product_key) <> ''
unit_price IS NOT NULL AND unit_price >= 0
unit_cost IS NULL OR unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= unit_cost
order_key IS NOT NULL AND order_line_number IS NOT NULL
count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_key, order_line_number) = 1
customer_key IN (SELECT customer_key FROM {quality_catalog}.sales.qa_customers)
product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM {quality_catalog}.sales.qa_products)
quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0
net_amount IS NULL OR abs(net_amount - (quantity * unit_price - coalesce(discount_amount, 0))) <= 0.01
order_date IS NOT NULL AND order_date <= current_date()
ship_date IS NULL OR order_date IS NULL OR ship_date >= order_date
return_key IS NOT NULL
count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY return_key) = 1
return_quantity IS NOT NULL AND return_quantity > 0
product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM {quality_catalog}.sales.qa_products)
return_date IS NOT NULL AND return_date <= current_date()
employee_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee_key) <> ''
count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_key) = 1
employee_key IN (SELECT employee_key FROM {quality_catalog}.sales.qa_employees)
employee_key IN (SELECT employee_key FROM {quality_catalog}.sales.qa_employees)
vorm_code IS NOT NULL AND vorm_code <> '' AND wijk_code IS NOT NULL AND wijk_code <> '' AND periode_code IS NOT NULL AND periode_code <> ''
(jongeren_totaal IS NULL OR jongeren_totaal >= 0) AND (trajecten_totaal IS NULL OR trajecten_totaal >= 0)
currency_code IS NOT NULL AND currency_code <> '' AND rate_date IS NOT NULL
rate_to_eur IS NOT NULL AND rate_to_eur > 0
holiday_date IS NOT NULL AND holiday_name IS NOT NULL AND holiday_name <> '' AND country_code = 'NL'
holiday_types IS NOT NULL AND size(holiday_types) > 0
sales_order_detail_id IS NOT NULL AND count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sales_order_detail_id) = 1
order_quantity > 0 AND unit_price >= 0 AND unit_price_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND total_due_amount >= 0
source_last_modified_at IS NOT NULL
